question: When is this procedure declared for everyone to be performed?
premises: The procedure is declared for all.
It is set at the end of birth impurity.
It is to occur on an auspicious day.
inference: Thus it is declared for all at the end of impurity on an auspicious day.
plain_english: Thus it is declared for all at the end of the period of birth impurity, on an auspicious day.
